title: hotfix: SLO enforcer connection reset during regional failover
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Fix race that caused SLO enforcer to reset connections during region failover, preventing excessive load-shedding.
description: Motivation: urgent hotfix for production incident where SLO enforcer reset active connections during a multi-region failover leading to excessive load-shedding and tenant impact. Root cause: a race between regional-failover state transitions and connection pool drain logic that caused the enforcer to mark upstream connections as failed while a graceful handoff was underway. Scope: small, targeted fix in enforcer and connection pool with minimal behavioral change outside failover windows. Checklist: [x] reproduce failure in integ sim; [x] add defensive guards to failover transition; [x] add unit + integ test; [x] run canary in us-west-2; [x] monitor SLO regressions post-merge. Commits summary: "fix: guard connection reset during failover transitions"; "test: add failover+drain integ test"; "doc: operations note on failover backoff". Changed areas: slo/enforcer/manager.go (main guard logic), slo/enforcer/failover.go (state transition ordering), pkg/network/conn_pool.go (drain reset race fix), slo/probes/healthcheck.go (stability), docs/operations/slo-failover.md, tests/integ/failover_sim.go. Testing: unit tests cover transition ordering + conn pool invariants; integration sim reproduces the reset scenario and verifies no resets in controlled window; ran local load tests and a canary rollout (us-west-2) with zero SLO regression. CI: initial CI showed flaky integration failure (timeout on failover sim) which was addressed by increasing the test harness timeout and re-running; final CI green. Review convo: "Miguel Torres: Can the transition guard cause stalls if a region flaps rapidly?" => "Aisha: guard is time-bounded and falls back to safe reset after 30s; added test for flapping"; "Jia Li: prefer explicit metric for guarded resets" => "Aisha: added metric slo.enforcer.failover_guard.events"; "Ravi Menon: lgtm pending CI" => approved after CI green. Deployment & rollout: squash-merge to main, deployed to canary region, monitored for 24h, then full rollout across regions with feature flag default-on. Monitoring: added alerts for unexpected connection resets and increased sampling on SLO enforcer traces. Follow-ups: ENG-5821 (longer-term refactor of failover FSM), ENG-5830 (connection pool observability); ops runbook updated. Merge: merged via squash, no manual rollback required. Notes: small behavioral change only during failover window; included ops note and postmortem link (internal/incident/INC-2026-02-19).
